# assingment-3-btf26


## Ben Furber Assingment-3-btf26 collaboration

The following webpage is an assignment on collaboration practicing
pulling and pushing quarto documents from a github repo.The purpose of
this lesson is to prevent merge errors in the future when multiple
people are working with the same documents. In this exercise a pair of
collaborators took turns making simple edits to a website each created
at the beginning on the assignment.
